purpose: Build root for tools/build-mesa-root.py: the pinned Ubuntu Base for
Ubuntu 26.04 arm64 with Mesa's build dependencies from a pinned archive
snapshot, used on hosts that are not ARM64. The Mesa source itself stays
pinned only in source.json. glslang-tools (glslangValidator >= 12.2) is
required to build the Turnip Vulkan driver; libvulkan-dev and vulkan-tools
provide the loader headers and vulkaninfo for checks in the build root.
The other packages match the native desktop build.

apt.note: Archive signatures are checked with the keyring shipped in build_root; the pinned snapshot fixes the build-dependency versions.
